name: application-error-page
title: 404 / Error Page
description: Full-page error states with a status code, headline, message, and home/back or reload actions, for a route that failed to resolve or crashed entirely.
useWhen: A route doesn't exist or fails to resolve, and the user needs a way back to known-good content.
An unrecoverable error occurs at the route/render level rather than within one section of an otherwise working page.
Replacing the entire page content because there is nothing partial left to show.
avoidWhen: The failure is scoped to one section or widget within an otherwise functional page — use retry-error-state instead so the rest of the page stays usable.
The user lacks permission rather than the resource being missing or the app having crashed — use a permission-denied state instead, since the messaging and remedy differ.
responsiveBehavior: Content is centered and vertically stacked with a constrained message width (max-w-sm); the layout holds at any viewport without additional breakpoints beyond the heading's text size step at sm.
accessibility: The heading is a real <h1> so the page has a correct document outline even though it replaces the normal route content.
Primary and secondary actions are distinguishable both visually (filled vs. text) and by their accessible names (Go back home vs. Go back / Reload page vs. Contact support).
The status code (404 / Error 500) is presented as supporting text before the heading, not as the only signal of what happened — the heading and message carry the full meaning.

variants.title: 404 Not Found
variants.description: Full-page not-found state with a home and back action
accessibility: The 404 code is presented as secondary text; the h1 and body copy carry the full meaning independently.

variants.title: 404 Not Found (Dark)
variants.description: Full-page not-found state with a home and back action
accessibility: Colors meet WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces.

variants.title: 500 Server Error
variants.description: Full-page crash state with an icon, reload action, and a support contact link
accessibility: The warning icon is decorative and aria-hidden; the heading and message independently convey the crash state.

variants.title: 500 Server Error (Dark)
variants.description: Full-page crash state with an icon, reload action, and a support contact link
accessibility: Colors meet WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces.
